def test_transform(grid):
    s1 = grid[0:3]
    s2 = grid[3:6]
    s3 = grid[6:9]
    s4 = grid[9:12]
    
    result = []
    for row in range(3):
        nonzero_s1 = [c for c in s1[row] if c != 0]
        single_color = len(set(nonzero_s1)) == 1
        
        output_row = []
        for col in range(6):
            v1, v2, v3, v4 = s1[row][col], s2[row][col], s3[row][col], s4[row][col]
            
            if v1 == 0:
                if single_color:
                    # Fill in priority: s2, then s3, then s4, then 0
                    if v2 != 0:
                        out = v2
                    elif v3 != 0:
                        out = v3
                    elif v4 != 0:
                        out = v4
                    else:
                        out = 0
                else:
                    # Multi-color: fill only from s3, s4 (not s2)
                    if v3 != 0:
                        out = v3
                    elif v4 != 0:
                        out = v4
                    else:
                        out = 0
            else:
                # s1 has value - keep it (no conflict resolution)
                out = v1
            
            output_row.append(out)
        result.append(output_row)
    
    return result
